title: Linear bound on expected comparisons
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $l$ be a finite list in $\alpha$. The expected number of comparisons made by the randomized selection procedure is at most $10|l|$.
